items.habitat: Warm Coastal Seas and Open Oceans
facts: Dolphins are friendly, intelligent marine mammals that breathe air through a blowhole on top of their head!
Dolphins talk to each other under the sea using clicks and whistles and love leaping over waves.
items.sound_description: Playful series of rapid clicks and high-pitched whistles.
items.suggested_learning_activity: Dolphin Wave Leap: Put your hands together in front and make a smooth jumping wave motion through the air!
